name: wave-hello
title: Wave hello
blurb: Raises an open hand and waves hi

name: bow
title: Take a bow
blurb: Stands proud, then bows low and rises

name: nod
title: Nod yes
blurb: Nods its head yes, three times

name: shake-no
title: No no no
blurb: Shakes its whole head side to side: no!

name: shrug
title: Shrug
blurb: Palms up, head cocked: I dunno!

name: celebrate
title: Celebrate!
blurb: Rises tall and pumps its fist twice

name: happy-dance
title: Happy dance
blurb: A little side-to-side sway with gripper snaps

name: robot-dance
title: Robot dance
blurb: Stiff, angular pops like an 80s robot

name: disco-point
title: Disco point
blurb: Points to the sky, then down across. Disco!

name: gripper-clap
title: Clap along
blurb: Bobs and claps its gripper to the beat

name: conductor
title: Conductor
blurb: Conducts four bars of 4/4 with a baton

name: high-five-offer
title: High five?
blurb: Reaches up and out for a high five

name: thinking
title: Hmm, thinking
blurb: Cocks its head and taps its chin. Aha!

name: curious-sniff
title: Curious sniff
blurb: Leans in to sniff you, then startles back

name: peekaboo
title: Peekaboo
blurb: Hides low, peeks, then pops up: boo!

name: look-around
title: Look around
blurb: Turns left and right to scan the room

name: sleepy-stretch
title: Sleepy stretch
blurb: Dozes, yawns wide, then stretches up tall

name: figure-eight
title: Figure eight
blurb: Draws a giant 8 in the air, wrist rolling, claw snapping

name: ripple
title: Ripple
blurb: A wave runs base to fingertip and back, twice

name: conductor-finale
title: Grand finale
blurb: Conducts the last bars, big final downbeat, bow

name: tornado
title: Tornado
blurb: Spins up in growing laps, then spirals down
